The learned Additional Government Advocate accepts notice for the respondents No.1, 2, 3, 5 and 6.
2.

The land bearing Sy.No.96/2+3+4/1A measuring 6 acres 31 guntas, land bearing Sy.No.98/2+3A/1 measuring 2 acres, Sy.No.80/3 measuring 2 acres 33 guntas and Sy.No.81/2 meausring 0.20 guntas were acquired for the purpose of Upper Krishna Project by issuing notification under Section 11(1) dated 28.10.2015.
However, the same was not followed by issuing a final notification within the time specified.
Thereafter, a preliminary notification was issued under Section 11 of the Act, 2013 dated 20.11.2021 culminating in issuing final notification under Section 19 of the Act, 2013 on 13.11.2022.
The petitioners submitted representations with the respondents to conclude the acquisition proceedings by determining the compensation payable by passing an award.
3. The petitioners' grievance is that the said representations has not been considered.

4. The learned High Court Government Pleader for the State on instructions submits that the representations submitted by the petitioners will be considered in accordance with law if reasonable time is granted.

5. Therefore, it is expedient to dispose of the petition directing the respondents No.1, 5 and 6 to consider the representations dated 7.9.2013 and 8.9.2013 submitted by the NC: 2024:KHC-D:859 petitioners at Annexures-L to L5 and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of four months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

Sd/-
